findings.summary: Resolved at the target revision. The incorporated round-two section 5 requires the platform pod's own currently credentialed DHS Trusted Tester at Gate 3 for every new UI, and binds verified identity, accessibility-specialist hat, DHS qualification validity, platform-pod assignment validity and provider proof to exact Exam and implementation revisions. findings.summary: The incorporated Trusted Tester evidence contract does not preserve A9.2's mandatory environment coverage. Governing A9.2 requires Windows 11 plus Chrome and JAWS, Windows 11 plus Firefox and NVDA, macOS plus Safari and VoiceOver, iOS plus Safari and VoiceOver, and Android plus Chrome and TalkBack, with desktop keyboard-only passes separately. Round-two section 5 instead calls a different set the exact five versioned families, and the bound schema permits only Linux Chromium keyboard-only, Linux Firefox keyboard-only, macOS Safari VoiceOver, Windows Firefox NVDA, and Windows Edge high-contrast/zoom. The supersession map replaces only the reviewer-qualification/evidence portion of OR-22/A9.2, not its environment scope. As written, schema-valid release evidence can omit JAWS, iOS VoiceOver, and Android TalkBack entirely while claiming the exact required family set passed.
findings.requiredResolution: Create one non-contradictory, explicitly superseded environment registry and enforce it identically in OR-22/A9.2, the Trusted Tester schema, fixtures, and semantic validator. At minimum preserve the named Windows Chrome+JAWS, Windows Firefox+NVDA, macOS Safari+VoiceOver, iOS Safari+VoiceOver, and Android Chrome+TalkBack combinations and the separately required desktop keyboard-only passes. Reject any omitted, substituted, duplicated, stale, or unversioned environment, refresh all affected digests, and obtain a new exact-revision review.

findings.summary: The bound Trusted Tester schema and semantic validator permit a structural false pass that defeats the Exam's omission controls. A9.2 requires raw A01-A81 results for every applicable scenario/environment pair, and the 81-checkpoint model requires each checkpoint/scenario row to carry route/state ID, viewport, browser/OS/assistive-technology versions, operator, start/end timestamps, outcome, notes, evidence references, and exact Exam and implementation revisions. The schema's raw line has exactly four fields, and the validator requires exactly 81 total lines, one environment per checkpoint. Its own positive fixture distributes those 81 rows 17/16/16/16/16 across five environments, although five environments alone require at least 405 checkpoint pairs before the required scenario expansion. The same validator also accepts a summary pass when all 81 checkpoints are marked not-applicable with no criterion-specific rationale, even though OR-22 requires that rationale. Missing route, state, scenario, viewport, environment, and evidence rows can therefore produce a green technical-release predicate.
findings.requiredResolution: Replace the one-row-per-checkpoint oracle with a manifest-derived exhaustive matrix keyed by route or Storybook surface, state, scenario, viewport, environment, and checkpoint. Every raw row must carry all fields required by the bound checkpoint model, including exact environment versions, operator, timestamps, notes, evidence references, and exact Exam/implementation revisions. Require criterion-specific human rationale for each not-applicable disposition; derive the summary only after proving exact expected-key equality, uniqueness, raw-to-summary equality, and zero missing or extra rows. Add positive full-matrix evidence and negative fixtures deleting or substituting every dimension, plus an all-not-applicable-without-rationale rejection. Refresh all affected digests and obtain a new exact-revision review.
